title: Readiness 90 requires real PoE candidate part selection
rootCause: PoE fixture readiness stalled when the board was PCB-clean but still described major blocks as generic placeholders or simplified candidates.
fixSummary: Select explicit candidate MPN rows for RJ45/MagJack, PD controller, Ethernet interface, bridge/front-end, TVS, isolated power, regulator, and supporting passives while keeping stock and assembly unverified unless supplier APIs are configured.
